Filter out canceled and unavailable orders using the business glossary status filter.
Group by seller_id and sum the order_items.price to calculate total revenue per seller.
Order the results by total revenue descending and select the top 5 sellers.

data.text: Good, I have the schema. Now I'll run the SQL query to get the top 5 sellers by revenue:

args.purpose: Top 5 sellers by total revenue (sum of order_items.price) from non-canceled/non-unavailable orders
args.sql:
SELECT 
    s.seller_id,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
